sourceNote: ニンジャスピナー: MEASURED by pokemon-infomation.com across ~1,000 aggregated boxes (30,000 packs). Their per-BOX figures: SR(ポケモン/サポート) ~80.0%; Trainer-line SR (グッズ/ポケモンのどうぐ/スタジアム) 1枚確定; SAR ~28.0%; MUR ~1.0-2.0%; AR 3枚確定; RR 4-5枚; ~10% of boxes carry two SR-or-better. Mapped: ultra_rare takes the 0.8 SR band PLUS the 1.0 guaranteed Trainer SR = 1.8/box; special_illustration_rare the 28% SAR; mega_hyper_rare the MUR at the 1.5% midpoint of the stated 1-2% range (this catalog holds exactly one MUR card); illustration_rare the guaranteed 3 AR; double_rare the 4-5 RR (4.5 used). Rates come from ポケゲトちゃんねる (pokemon-infomation.com), which aggregates real box-opening tallies from card shops and individuals — the closest thing Japanese sets have to a primary study, since neither The Pokemon Company nor any English source publishes Japanese odds. Confidence is MEDIUM: the sample is large and the methodology is consistent across sets, but the tallies are not independently auditable. Per-pack probabilities are the site's per-BOX figures divided by this box's 30 packs. NOTE ON GUARANTEES: per-box guarantees are FOLDED INTO the slot rates rather than modelled as engine floors — a floor attaches to a PRODUCT, so a single-pack product would inherit the whole box's guarantee and read absurdly positive.
